Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original full-body 2D battle character for a university campus deckbuilding game, intended to be rigged for expressive animation.
Shared style: Premium hand-painted 2D game character, bold readable silhouette, economical dark painted outlines, confident angular shapes with warm/cool cel-painted volumes, controlled painterly texture, clear three-value lighting, coherent upper-left light. Crisp stage-sized readability. Adult proportions and expressive balanced posing. No watercolor wash, no chibi, no 3D render, no photorealism, no UI, no letters, no logo or watermark.
Subject: One original Chinese male university student, age 21, named Lin Xu in our design (do not write his name). Thoughtful, observant systems problem-solver. Short slightly tousled black hair, slim rectangular glasses, charcoal teal casual zip jacket over an ochre cream shirt, straight dark trousers, worn brown low-top sneakers. Small dark red notebook tucked into a side pocket. A compact silver laptop in his left hand at waist height, right hand holding a mechanical pencil ready to annotate. Natural healthy anatomy, visibly adult, approachable and focused. Distinctive asymmetrical jacket hem and rolled cuffs. Clothing is contemporary campus clothing, never armor or fantasy costume.
Composition: One complete standing full-body character only, three-quarter side view facing RIGHT, camera at waist height, both shoes visible and planted on the same baseline. Head turns toward the right. Relaxed but alert slightly staggered stance with a credible center of gravity, six to seven heads tall. Leave readable gaps around elbows, wrists and between legs. The forward arm and the laptop are kept outside the torso silhouette as much as possible. All body parts connected naturally. Nothing cropped. Character fills about 84 percent of the height with generous margin around hands and shoes.
Backdrop: Absolutely flat solid vivid magenta #ff00ff, no floor, no shadow, no gradient, no horizon, no other objects. Do not use magenta anywhere on the character. This is a chroma-key production background, not transparency. Keep edges crisp without magenta bounce lighting.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original 2D animated task-creature for a university campus deckbuilding game. It personifies the existing task "after-class exercises", not a human teacher or a new story character.
Shared style: Premium hand-painted 2D game character, bold readable silhouette, economical dark painted outlines, confident angular shapes with warm/cool cel-painted volumes, controlled painterly texture, clear three-value lighting, coherent upper-left light. Crisp stage-sized readability. Adult proportions and expressive balanced posing. No watercolor wash, no chibi, no 3D render, no photorealism, no UI, no letters, no logo or watermark.
Subject: A single imposing but playful animated stack of university exercise worksheets and a battered teal clipboard, facing LEFT toward the player. The body is an upright, slightly hunched stack of cream paper bound by a large brass binder clip at the top. Two dark narrow ink eye shapes sit on the paper face; NO mouth full of teeth. Broad fanned sheets behind the body create an asymmetric shoulder silhouette. A long dark wooden mechanical pencil forms its forward articulated arm and points left; a second smaller curled paper-strip arm balances the other side. Two folded-paper feet support the body at ground level. Small abstract line diagrams and geometric shapes on the sheets, no readable text or digits. A small red corner tab distinguishes the task. It should look like an expressive adversary on a painted 2D battle stage, not a stationery still life or a card illustration.
Composition: One complete creature, full silhouette unobstructed, three-quarter side view facing LEFT. Main body about 55 percent of the frame width, including pencil about 80 percent. Both folded feet visible on a shared baseline, believable weight. Clear separation between moving body, rear sheet fan, binder clip and pencil arm for future cutout animation. Plenty of margin around pencil tip and upper clip.
Backdrop: Absolutely flat solid vivid magenta #ff00ff, no floor, no cast shadow, no gradient, no horizon, no other objects. Do not use magenta anywhere on the creature. This is a chroma-key production background, not transparency. Keep edges crisp without magenta bounce lighting.
